checkpoint: Every 100 iterations local temporary save. Every completed candidate automatically private archived + public aggregate sync before the next candidate.
comparison: Frozen last-record LightGBM unweighted and rare-sqrt already trained on exactly same 35,005 validation window targets
data_leakage_guard: categorical vocab fit exclusively on original training split; group-disjoint frozen partitions, no use of official test
data_source: UNSW-NB15 official TRAINING partition only; 82,332 official TEST never opened
feature_spec: All five rows in each split-local, CSV-ordered SCV window, named lag4 oldest to lag0 target; native categorical proto/service/state for all lags; no attack label/id feature
objective: Does exposing all 5 split-local records (instead of only final one) improve joint accuracy and macro-F1? Exploratory internal validation only, no held-out official superiority claim
warning: CSV row ordering has NOT been verified as temporal continuity. Lag refers only to serialized window position, not real chronology.
